vt51_takeoff_jun44.jpg.description: A U.S. Navy General Motors TBM-1C Avenger of Torpedo Squadron 51 (VT-51) takes off from the light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) for a raid on Guam, 28 June 1944. The catapult operator is visibla at right.

vt51_launch_may44.jpg.description: U.S. Navy Lieutenant Commander Albert B. Cahn gives the take-off signal to a Grumman TBM-1C Avenger of Torpedo Squadron 51 (VT-51) aboard the light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30), during exercises on 16 May 1944.

vt51_majuro.jpg.credit: Official U.S. Navy photo 80-G-238779 from the U.S. Navy Naval History and Heritage Command
vt51_majuro.jpg.description: A U.S. Navy Grumman TBM-1C Avenger from Torpedo Squadron 51 (VT-51) flying over Majuro Atoll, Marshall Islands, on 30 May 1944. VT-51 was assigned to Carrier Air Group 51 (CVG-51) aboard the light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) from late 1943 to December 1944.

sanjac_philly.jpg.title: USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) off the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard on 17 January 1944 (NH 43506).jpg
sanjac_philly.jpg.description: The U.S. Navy light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) off the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard, Pennsylvania (USA), on 17 January 1944. She is painted in camouflage Measure 33, Design 7a.

sanjac_underway.jpg.title: USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) underway at sea on 23 January 1944 (80-G-212798).jpg

sanjac_underway.jpg.description: The U.S. Navy light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) underway off the U.S. East Coast on 23 January 1944, with a North American SNJ Texan training plane parked on her flight deck. The ship is painted in Camouflage Measure 33, Design 7A.

sanjac_lexington.jpg.description: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30), right foreground, steaming in formation with USS Lexington (CV-16) and a Farragut-class destroyer, during pre-invasion operations in the Marianas area, 13 June 1944. Both carriers belonged to Task Group 58.3.

sanjac_may44.jpg.description: The U.S. Navy light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) launching Grumman F6F Hellcats from Fighting Squadron 51 (VF-51) in the vicinity of Majuro Atoll on 31 May 1944. San Jacinto wears Camouflage Measure 33, Design 7A.

sanjac_hangar.jpg.description: U.S. Navy sailors (and Marines) in the hangar bay of the light aircraft carrier USS San Jacinto (CVL-30) on 18 April 1944. San Jacinto was most probably transporting men and equipment to the Pacific war zone.

tbm_saipan.jpg.title: General Motors TBM-1C Avenger of VT-2 enroute to Saipan, circa in June 1944 (80-G-428459).jpg
tbm_saipan.jpg.description: A U.S. Navy General Motors TBM-1C Avenger of Torpedo Squadron 2 (VT-2) enroute to Saipan, circa in June 1944. VT-2 was assigned to Carrier Air Group 2 (CVG-2) aboard the aircraft carrier USS Hornet (CV-12) in mid-1944. Aircraft from Hornet were identified by the white circle on the tail.

tbm_torpedo_wasp.jpg.title: TBM Avenger with Mark 13 torpedo aboard USS Wasp (CV-18), 13 October 1944 (80-G-298609).jpg
tbm_torpedo_wasp.jpg.description: U.S. Navy flight deck crews aboard the aircraft carrier USS Wasp (CV-18) prepare to load a Mark XIII torpedo on a Grumman TBM Avenger of Torpedo Squadron 14 (VT-14), during strikes in the Luzon-Formosa area, 13 October 1944. Note the plywood shrouds on the torpedo's fins and nose. The plane at right is a Grumman F6F Hellcat of Fighting Squadron 14 (VF-14), others visible are TBMs.

tbf_charger_colour.jpg.title: Grumman TBF Avenger landing aboard USS Charger (CVE-30) on 22 April 1944 (80-G-K-1518).jpg
tbf_charger_colour.jpg.description: A U.S. Navy Grumman TBF (or TBM) Avenger torpedo plane landing aboard the escort carrier USS Charger (CVE-30), during flight training operations in the Chesapeake Bay Area, 22 April 1944. Note the flight deck crewmen in the galleries and the ship's angular smokestack.
